caption: "muse" — 200,000+ searches this week. Meta's new AI app.

Why: Meta launched Muse on September 8, an AI agent that does things instead of just answering: it sends email, books travel and shops. It has been No. 1 on the US App Store since September 18. Meta stock jumped more than 11% on September 21, its biggest one-day rise since April 2025.

What most people don't know: Muse is free because Meta expects to be paid at the checkout. At Meta Connect on September 23, Mark Zuckerberg said Meta will profit "by taking a small fee from transactions." Walmart, Best Buy, Sephora and Instacart have signed on.
Very simply put: the app is free because the checkout isn't.
